evidence.detail: history command takes a single Card parameter via slash_card_option; no multi-card or '+' parsing exists
slash_card_option wraps a single STRING option with autocomplete; no mechanism for multiple card inputs

triage.notes: Supporting '+'-delimited multi-card input requires product decisions: parse the string (losing per-card autocomplete), add card2/card3 optional slash-command options, or create a dedicated multi-card command. Output format for combined histories also needs definition.
